status: REGRESSION under the pre-registered H4 rule, stopped early per the pre-registered early-stop rule. The entropy fix did what it was built to do; a SECOND, independent mechanism collapses the policy.
what_ran: Direct SAC/RLPD fine-tuning of the OFT head from the BC policy with latent entropy, corrected std change-of-variables, calibrated target -1.75, and a 300-update critic-only warmup (run6_preregistration.json).

readout.note_on_scale: The in-trainer path scores the UNCHANGED policy 0.76 (g1_piston_in_trainer_eval_underscores.json). 0.76 -> 0.80 during warmup is preservation; 0.48 -> 0.04 after 150 actor updates is collapse.

logp.reading: sits at the target; the entropy term is regulating, not shrinking

the_signature_is_different_and_that_is_t.runs_4_and_5: raw head magnitude 0.415 -> 0.24 (flattened), deployed error 11.5-13.8 deg, alpha rising, entropy 28% of the objective
the_signature_is_different_and_that_is_t.run_6: raw head magnitude 0.415 -> 0.446 (NOT flattened), deployed error 7.3 deg, alpha stable, logp at target
the_signature_is_different_and_that_is_t.reading: The pre-registered falsifier was 'grasp collapsing with raw magnitude ~0.25 again'. That did not happen: the flattening mechanism is absent, so the entropy diagnosis stands and its fix is verified in a live run. The policy nevertheless moved 7.3 degrees away from the demonstrations in a direction that does not shrink it. The only remaining term in the actor objective is the critic's Q-gradient. Direct fine-tuning therefore fails through critic-driven drift once entropy is fixed.

why_this_matches_the_literature: This is the failure mode the offline-to-online literature attributes to an uncalibrated or exploitable critic (Cal-QL arXiv 2303.05479; WSRL arXiv 2412.07762), and the reason ResFiT (arXiv 2509.19301) and RLPD (arXiv 2302.02948) bound the actor's freedom or avoid pretrained actors: a 42M-parameter head following a 2-critic Q-gradient over 900 action dimensions with ~8 transitions per dimension can find action directions the critic over-values.
next_test_no_simulator: Rank actions with run 6's own critic on demonstration frames: Q(a_run6) vs Q(a_BC) vs Q(a_demo). If the critic rates the drifted action above the BC action while the environment scores it far lower, critic exploitation is confirmed as the mechanism.
consequence: Run 7 (frozen base + bounded residual, R_MAX 0.15) is now the registered arm that limits how far critic-driven drift can move the executed action. Stopping run 6 early released the GPU to it ~1 h sooner.
unaffected: The BC policy and its videos; the entropy mean-force finding (confirmed absent here, as predicted).
